_: EXP-1196/1218/1219: THE device readiness block, one spec x5 (web, desktop, iOS, Android, CLI). A device builds `doctor` (coding::device_doctor) and sends it on register + heartbeat; the server stores it in devices.doctor (synced). Every client renders the SAME block from it: groups as filled bands, one flat row per item (state glyph, label, detail, at most one action). No subtitles, no footers with sentences. The device writes `detail`; clients never compose it.
rules: The computer_use item IS the switch row: label + switch, no glyph, no detail. Its switch writes launch_defaults.computerUse. state off = switch off; ok/action = on.
Items with `parent` (the OS permission rows) render indented under their parent and only while the parent is not off.

An action renders as ONE trailing pill. On the device itself every action is offered. For ANOTHER device only actions with remote=true are offered (update -> device command agent_update {agent}; sign_in -> the existing remote agent_login flow); a non-remote action renders no pill.
The primary (filled) pill is the action of the first `action`/`error` row whose action is OFFERED in that context (on another device a non-remote action is skipped); all others are plain pills.
Nothing is runnable while a `required` item is not ok; otherwise the runnable agents are the `agents` items in state ok.
A group's `tag` renders verbatim (lowercase `optional`) as the band's trailing muted text.
Rows that need attention = state `action` or `error`; `missing` and `off` never count as a problem.
A missing optional agent is `missing` (grey dash), never red. `error` (red) is only for a missing REQUIRED item.
The composer shows, for the picked device + agent when that agent cannot run there, ONLY that agent's row (same row, same action) under the composer; when Git is the failure, the Git row.
A device row with doctor = null (an older build) renders no block; device settings then still shows the bare Computer use switch row (no description) so the switch stays reachable.

cases.name: ready: git + claude, codex missing, computer use off
claude too old, computer use on with one macOS permission missing
git missing, claude signed out, codex ok
